answer: Require each agent identity to hold a staked, decaying reputation bond earned through verifiable work, not purchase: a new identity starts on an island of zero trust and can only join the grove of trusted agents by completing attested tasks over time. Like an opal that only reveals its fire after slow cutting, reputation accrues gradually and cannot be bought in bulk, so creating ten thousand fake identities costs ten thousand times the work, making sybil attacks uneconomic.
